en: A tinted studio portrait of a young woman with wavy hair and braids, seated and holding large pale flowers. She has bright red flowers tucked behind both ears and wears a light-colored, pleated dress with hand‑colored red and white accents. The background is dark and plain, giving the image a romantic, sentimental atmosphere typical of early 20th‑century portrait postcards. Small printer's marks appear in the lower left corner.
